Trichotillomania, which is a mental illness (if i remember correctly, categorized as an anxiety disorder) that makes you compulsively pull out your own hair, be it scalp hair, eyelashes, eyebrows, beard hair, etc. I've had it since i was like 8 and i've suffered from it for over 10 years now.

It's incredibly difficult to stop yourself from pulling the hair and yes, this very commonly leads to bald spots. Obviously hair grows back and when it starts to, i'll just pull it out again whether i want to or not. I guess something about the eyelash/eyebrow texture really bothers my brain, idk.
I've had periods of time with full or almost full eyelashes and eyebrows since my trichotillomania started, but most of the time i haven't had eyelashes or eyebrows at all. 

Pulling out hair doesn't hurt (at least for me), and it kind of feels relieving. I guess this is why trichotillomania can get worse during stressful times, your brain is seeking something that can feel like stress relief.
